candidates.structural_interaction: Water generating Wood cross-polarity — depth producing reach that exceeds its container
candidates.k2_overview: Your Wood moves as the Virtuoso: growth that will not stay trellised. You branch where the plan said hedge, flower out of season, and produce originality the way forests produce spring, excessively and without apology. Every constraint reads as a suggestion. Your best work grows exactly where they told you nothing could.

k2_functional.mind: You think in wild branches: the unplanned connection, the growth no gardener predicted.
k2_functional.expression: You express organically and abundantly, ideas leafing faster than any format can hold.
k2_functional.bonds: You draw people who love wildness and alarm people who prune. Both are correct.
k2_functional.action: You work in growth spurts toward light only you see. Fences slow you less than doubt.
k2_functional.body: Your energy is sap-driven: surging seasons, then hard winters that demand real rest.

k2_domain_readings.Talent: Your talent is generative: new shoots daily, whole canopies of ideas. The gift needs an editor the way forests need clearings. Cut sightlines through your own abundance so the best trees show.
k2_domain_readings.Performance: You perform by unveiling growth: the project no one authorized, suddenly in bloom. Time the reveals. A garden shown at flowering converts skeptics that a garden shown as seeds cannot.
k2_domain_readings.Defiance: Your defiance is botanical: quiet, continuous, growing over walls rather than arguing with them. It wins by finished fact. Just verify the wall you are overgrowing is not holding your own soil.
